steps.step: UE initiates the procedure by sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST message to the AMF, indicating the appropriate 5GS registration type (e.g., "initial registration", "emergency registration").
UE starts timer T3510.
If timer T3502 is running, UE stops timer T3502.
If timer T3511 is running, UE stops timer T3511.
If SUCI is included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST and timer T3519 is not running, UE starts timer T3519.
AMF receives the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
AMF may initiate 5GMM common procedures (e.g., identification, authentication, security).
If the initial registration request is accepted by the network, AMF sends a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the UE.

If specific IEs (e.g., 5G-GUTI, SOR transparent container, Operator-defined access category definitions, Extended emergency number list, CAG information list, Negotiated PEIPS assistance information, UE radio capability ID, Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration, Service-level-AA pending, On-demand NSSAI, Configured NSSAI, NSSRG information, S-NSSAI time/location validity, NSAG information, Alternative NSSAI, Network slicing subscription change) are included in REGISTRATION ACCEPT requiring acknowledgment, AMF starts timer T3550 and enters state 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED.
UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
UE stops timer T3510 (implicitly, upon successful completion).
UE resets the registration attempt counter.
UE enters state 5GMM-REGISTERED and sets the 5GS update status to 5U1 UPDATED.

UE uses timer values provided in REGISTRATION ACCEPT (T3512, T3324, non-3GPP de-registration timer). Starts T3448 if T3448 value IE is included and not zero/deactivated. Stores or stops T3447 based on presence of T3447 value IE. Starts T3526 if S-NSSAI rejected due to max UEs with back-off timer.
If acknowledgment is required based on IEs received in REGISTRATION ACCEPT, UE sends a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF.
AMF receives the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.
AMF stops timer T3550.
If the initial registration request cannot be accepted, AMF sends a REGISTRATION REJECT message to the UE including a 5GMM cause value.
UE receives the REGISTRATION REJECT message.
UE stops timer T3510 (implicitly, upon receiving reject).

UE performs actions based on the 5GMM cause value, which may include changing state (e.g., 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-SUPI, 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH, 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE, 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION), changing update status (e.g., 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, 5U2 NOT UPDATED), deleting context, and starting timers (e.g., T3346, T3245, T3526).

Abnormal Case (UE): T3510 expires. UE aborts the procedure, stops T3510, increments registration attempt counter. If counter < 5, starts T3511 and enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION. If counter = 5, deletes context, starts T3502 (if > 0), enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or PLMN-SEARCH.
Abnormal Case (AMF): T3550 expires (after retransmissions). AMF aborts the procedure, enters 5GMM-REGISTERED, considers old and new 5G-GUTIs temporarily valid.
